title: And For The Lady, Perhaps... The Gift List
trend: Instagram Reels 'And For the Lady, Perhaps' (text 'And for the [person], perhaps...' then that person's perfect treat; New Engen Instagram list updated Nov 6 2026, US) + nostalgic toys leading US holiday gift searches (toy train sets and roller skates top Google's Holiday 100, Nov 9 2026) — Grandpa Walt presents the family gift list like a fancy waiter and every gift is a toy train; twist: Grandma Odessa found his old train in September, bought him new track, and the roller skates are for both of them
youtube_title: And for the lady, perhaps... Grandpa's holiday gift list 🚂
description:
Grandpa Walt presents the family gift list like a fancy waiter. Somehow every gift is a toy train. Grandma Odessa has her own menu.

lines.text: Good evening. Tonight I present the family holiday gift list. Like a fine restaurant.
Walter, you have a towel on your arm.
Every good waiter has a towel. And for the lady, perhaps...
Roller skates.
I have not skated since nineteen seventy nine.
I remember. You took out a disco ball.
The disco ball took me out. There is a difference.
These have brakes. And little lights in the wheels.
Little lights. Hmm. Continue.
Grandpa, did you make my list too? I wrote it down very clearly.
And for the young man, perhaps...
A toy train set.
I asked for a phone.
This train has a whistle. It is like a phone, but everybody can hear it.
That is the opposite of a phone.
Good evening. I am the train. Please do not return me.
Why is the train talking?
I have been in the attic since nineteen eighty seven. I have a lot to say.
Walter. That is your train.
It is everybody's train. It is a family train.
He played with me every night until his mother hid me behind the Christmas tree box.
It was a dark time for both of us.
What else is on the menu?
And for the baby, perhaps...
We do not have a baby, Walter.
For the baby we might have one day. Perhaps... a toy train set.
That is the same train.
It is a second train. They can be friends.
I would love a friend. The attic mouse only talks about cheese.
And for the dog, perhaps?
A train.
And for your cousin Darlene?
A train. With a card that says I am sorry about the boat.
Grandpa. How many trains are on this list?
Eleven. And a track that goes around the whole house.
Through the kitchen?
Through the kitchen, under the couch, past the bathroom. With a little tunnel.
A tunnel. I have never been in a tunnel. I have only been in a box.
Walter. Sit down. I have a menu too.
You do?
I have been planning since September. Towel.
Here is my towel.
Thank you. And for the gentleman, perhaps...
The train set he already has. I found it in the attic in September.
She cleaned my wheels. Nobody has cleaned my wheels since the eighties.
You knew?
I bought you eleven feet of new track. It is in the garage behind the snow shovel.
So Grandpa's whole list was for Grandpa.
Of course it was. Look at his face.
I am not crying. I have dust in my eye. From nineteen eighty seven.
And for the gentleman, perhaps... knee pads.
Why knee pads?
Because the roller skates are for you, too. We are skating to the train.
Can I get anything that is not a train?
And for the young man, perhaps... a phone.
Really?
To film your grandfather on skates. It will be a holiday tradition.
I want it noted that I was the waiter.
You were a lovely waiter. Your tip is a tunnel.
Excuse me. And for the train, perhaps?
For the train, perhaps... the whole house.
Finally. All aboard. Mind the couch.
